common.code: fork r12 (src/phd/forks/GeoGS-conf-guided-v1-r12, read-only as /source), module v6 inside it; image jointbuildgs:geogs-conf-guided-v1
common.command: the stage-0 command (scripts/phd/main_stage0_v1/run_fork_v6.command + run_stage0.schedule) with the stage-0 values (configs main_stage0_v1 stage0.values_as_r10), 30,000 iterations, -r 1 (1024 x 741), LoD2 initial direction cell method (--jbgs_prior_normal_mode cell for both priors), records of stage 0 (logs every 100, snapshots 2,000 / 5,000 / 10,000 / 15,000 / 20,000 / 30,000, dump 30,000, saves 15,000 / 30,000, tests 7,000 / 15,000 / 30,000); inputs = the stage-0 fork inputs fork_inputs/s61/<site> (training views = the box training views with a geometric depth map; evaluation views = every eighth, split.json); PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True for every training
common.mounts: the stage-0 payload read-only (/p), this payload (/o) for the model; nothing written into the stage-0 payload
common.gpus: two RTX 3090 (24 GB), one training per GPU; the post steps (renders, TSDF, run steps, metrics) one at a time

methods.prop: all seven switches on; rule auto (LoD2 current = conflict beyond 1 tau; airborne LiDAR margin_all_2 = beyond 2 tau)
methods.imgonly: only the 'prior' switch off (no prior-origin Gaussians at initialisation, no prior depth term); the LoD2 scene's files (its images, cameras and image-origin initial points equal those of the ALS scene: 11,970 points at B173nb_b10, 7,442 at R1rep_b10, checked 2026-10-07)
methods.trust_ALS: the 'judgment' and 'prior_band' switches off (every patch agree, rho(r) = |r|: the prior is pulled everywhere without a band)
methods.prop_ALS1x: the method on the airborne LiDAR with the discard multiplier 1 (rule current) instead of 2 (margin_all_2); everything else as prop
methods.geogs: official GeoGS (zqlin0521/GeoGS, commit db40c95c657ec03ff21c83cb99cf39f4e90247a6) with the author settings; NOT started: inputs cannot be made equal with the author settings without a decision (DA3 visual depth = one inference over all images, beyond 24 GB here; the official reader drops the principal point (ours: up to 4.4 px off centre at 1024 x 741); R1rep split) -> asked before any GeoGS training

order: B173nb_b10 (3 + GeoGS) -> R1rep_b10 (7 + GeoGS) -> B0_b10 (7 + GeoGS) -> B173_b0 (6 + GeoGS), in this list order on the first free GPU

stop.oom: a CUDA out-of-memory: the same training once more; a second one: stop and ask
stop.other: an exit code != 0, a non-finite loss term, or (method / trust / ALS1x) the opacity collapse of the stage-0 signal: stop and ask
stop.time: if the whole task is likely to exceed twice the estimate: stop and ask
